verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a Session Workflow for multi-step execution: you run sequential tasks, goto, and extract calls in one persistent browser session, breaking complex workflows into smaller, more reliable steps (smooth-docs-7, smooth-docs-14, smooth-docs-34, smooth-docs-39). Structured outputs let deterministic code act on agent results (smooth-docs-5, smooth-docs-19). However, loops, conditionals and parameterization are not product-level workflow constructs; they come only from the developer's surrounding SDK code. Missing for 10: native loop/conditional/parameter workflow primitives, reusable saved workflow templates, independent hands-on corroboration.
